BiblicalUsage: Zeban is the Aramaic word for buying, or gaining, and it appears when Nebuchadnezzar catches his wise men stalling. I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, the king says, because they are trying to buy delay until he forgets the dream.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that stalling before God never works, because the time we try to buy is already His.
